fusions.name: False Echo
fusions.desc: Sings a misleading cone ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and stunning them for 1 second. Each hit has a 30% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Rise from Beneath
fusions.desc: Rises under the target, dealing 20 damage and consuming every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health. 50% more critical chance against a target that has not yet bled.

fusions.name: Thrown-Back Echo
fusions.desc: For 7 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead.

fusions.name: Played for Fools
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 12% against enemies carrying a condition.
